reasoning: On the season so far the Raptors are the stronger team; with home court the Raptors start about 9 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bucks.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bucks (revenge, streak).
Bottom line: the Raptors win 71 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 200 and 249 total points.

analyst.text: Milwaukee have lost 13 straight, the latest after Tyler Herro's career-high 50 fell just short in Philadelphia, and the cloud of the league's Gary Trent Jr. investigation hangs over the club. Toronto snapped a six-game skid in Detroit on Scottie Barnes' late layup, but Kawhi Leonard (knee, end-of-November target) and RJ Barrett are still out. The angle leans towards Toronto.
